source.provider: Federal Office of Topography swisstopo / geo.admin.ch
source.model: DTM2 / COMB source samples; 10 m measured municipal lattice with 50 m coarse scenery interpolation
source.note: Heights are metres AMSL, unexaggerated. Fine source values are unchanged. A 10 m sample spacing is not a claim of a native 10 m survey. Unmeasured scenery uses bilinear 50 m data and a harmonic correction transition outside the municipality only; thin outer halo clamps to the coarse edge. Interpolated values are rounded to 1 mm for storage, not measurement precision. The existing approximate WGS84-to-LV95 projection is retained.
